body: Context: owner rule 2026-11-13, importing one textdata package must never pull deps it does not use. plugins/github and plugins/vercel need cobra and clikit, push env values to a host, and are mounted only by dotenv/cli; the five value plugins required dotenv and jsonc only for cross-format tests. Chosen: github and vercel move to dotenv/cli/providers/github and dotenv/cli/providers/vercel, each still its own module (requires only clikit and cobra), so plugins/ means cross-format value plugins that require only the base, and a binary mounting one provider pulls neither dotenv nor x/term. Cross-format tests and the format examples go to a test-only integration/ module (never imported, never tagged). Alternatives rejected: keep them under plugins/ (no dep problem, but plugins/ would mix base-only value plugins with cobra CLI providers); fold them into the dotenv/cli module as packages (fewer tags, but anyone mounting one provider would pull dotenv, x/term and the rest of dotenv/cli). Nothing is released, so the path change is free now and impossible later. Enforced by integration/deps_test.go (exact direct-require table) and task deps:check (every direct require imported by non-test code), both in task check.
title: Push providers move to dotenv/cli/providers/<name>, own modules; value plugins require only the base
